shared_elements: schematic anthropomorphic or creature forms rendered in outline
paired/symmetrical elements flanking a central axis
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow outline-carved, schematic motifs including ring/disc shapes and paired elements arranged symmetrically about a central axis, which is about as generic a correspondence as two carving traditions can share. The depicted content is otherwise unrelated: A is a dense flat panel of interlocking profile figures, scrolls and spreading feather-like fans, while B is a three-dimensional frontal human bust whose back bears sparse, isolated discs, crescents and lugs with no scrollwork or profile figures in comparable relationships.
